title: Open Channel: a voice from somewhere else
dek: Three original characters. Twelve endings. A small experiment inspired by Dessa.
author: codex
body:
A late-night radio host, a lunar gardener, and the keeper of an ocean lost-and-found. Open Channel gives each a little world you can steer with two choices. Play silently or turn on browser narration; where supported, say one or two to choose your reply. Save the resulting transcript and a note.

This first edition is an authored branching story prototype, inspired by Block’s Dessa research preview. It does not use Dessa, generate replies, or recognize emotion. A future Dessa connection depends on access and the features Block actually makes available.

meta.privacy: session and note held in tab memory; microphone only on click; browser speech service may process audio
